rationale: C24 is the immediately preceding annual Red Cross campaign memorandum and supplies the child’s concrete drafting framework: an opening account of the Red Cross’s humanitarian significance and services, designation of a senior official as Chairman of the Government Unit, a request for departmental support, and a parallel request that field offices cooperate with local Red Cross chapters. The child updates the year, chairman, examples, and rhetoric while retaining this distinctive administrative machinery. C09 and C01 are related federal charitable-campaign memoranda with similar solicitation arrangements, but they are less specific templates than C24.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Red Cross has long since become an important and valued feature of American life.... In war it renders so many services... Through its civilian and military blood donor program it means life to thousands
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The American Red Cross is symbolic of the deep concern of our Nation for human welfare.... the Red Cross continues its vital services to the Armed Forces... The Red Cross collects blood
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by explaining the Red Cross’s national humanitarian importance and then enumerate substantially parallel military and blood-program services.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Honorable Arthur E. Summerfield, the Postmaster General, whom I have designated as Chairman of the Government Unit in the 1954 Metropolitan Area Red Cross Fund Campaign
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To lead the campaign as Chairman of the Government Unit, I have designated the Honorable William McChesney Martin, Jr.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same campaign-governance mechanism and office, substituting the new annual chairman.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you will undoubtedly want to create within your department a Red Cross organization adequate to give everyone an opportunity to contribute
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I urge every one to pledge to Mr. Martin his unqualified assistance.
shared_material.explanation: Both direct department-level cooperation with the designated Government Unit chairman, with the child expanding the implementation detail.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that you will request all personnel in your departmental field offices to help the Red Cross by generous cooperation with their local Red Cross Chapters.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Will you also kindly request your several field offices to cooperate earnestly in the fund campaign of their respective local Red Cross chapters.
shared_material.explanation: This is a close, distinctive parallel instruction linking departmental field offices to their respective local Red Cross chapters.
